required_output_fields.behavior: Required fields must not be empty in a valid output record.

conditional_fields.behavior: Fields that are not applicable to the statistic_type may be represented by an empty string.

null_empty_rules.empty_string_semantics: An empty string represents a field that is not applicable to the statistic type represented by the row. It does not necessarily mean missing source data.

deferred_rules: MITRE_STATISTICS remains DEFERRED until the actual ML event output is available.
The current Real ELK dataset must not be assumed to satisfy this contract.
No MITRE technique, attack type, attack stage, or MITRE attack name may be fabricated.
Mapped and unmapped session counts must not be invented when the required source relationship is unavailable.
Observed historical storage types do not imply that the current ML output will contain the same populated values.
The contract does not require reproducing the historical 57-row dataset until the current ML input is validated.
independence_rules: MITRE_STATISTICS must not modify source events.
MITRE_STATISTICS must not generate ML features.
MITRE_STATISTICS must not perform feature scaling.
MITRE_STATISTICS must not alter production cluster assignments.
MITRE_STATISTICS must not fabricate MITRE enrichment.
MITRE_STATISTICS must operate independently of downstream dashboard consumers.

availability.reason: The current Real ELK dataset does not provide sufficient validated MITRE data to execute and close MITRE_STATISTICS.
availability.activation_condition: Actual ML event output must be received and validated against the MITRE_STATISTICS input contract.
